1.web: Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
1.asv: Bless Jehovah, O my soul; And all that is within me, blesshis holy name.

2.web: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits;
2.asv: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, And forget not all his benefits:

3.web: who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases;
3.asv: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; Who healeth all thy diseases;

4.web: who redeems your life from destruction; who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies;
4.asv: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; Who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

5.web: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
5.asv: Who satisfieth thy desire with good things, So that thy youth is renewed like the eagle.

6.web: Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
6.asv: Jehovah executeth righteous acts, And judgments for all that are oppressed.

7.web: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.
7.asv: He made known his ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.

8.web: Yahweh is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.
8.asv: Jehovah is merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness.

9.web: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.
9.asv: He will not always chide; Neither will he keephis angerfor ever.

10.web: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.
10.asv: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, Nor rewarded us after our iniquities.

11.web: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.
11.asv: For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is his lovingkindness toward them that fear him.

12.web: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
12.asv: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

13.web: Like a father has compassion on his children, so Yahweh has compassion on those who fear him.
13.asv: Like as a father pitieth his children, So Jehovah pitieth them that fear him.

14.web: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
14.asv: For he knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.

15.web: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
15.asv: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

16.web: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
16.asv: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof shall know it no more.

17.web: But Yahweh’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children;
17.asv: But the lovingkindness of Jehovah is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, And his righteousness unto children’s children;

18.web: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.
18.asv: To such as keep his covenant, And to those that remember his precepts to do them.

19.web: Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.
19.asv: Jehovah hath established his throne in the heavens; And his kingdom ruleth over all.

20.web: Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
20.asv: Bless Jehovah, ye his angels, That are mighty in strength, that fulfil his word, Hearkening unto the voice of his word.

21.web: Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
21.asv: Bless Jehovah, all ye his hosts, Ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

22.web: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!
22.asv: Bless Jehovah, all ye his works, In all places of his dominion: Bless Jehovah, O my soul.
